correctness.rationale: The proof precisely defines failure events F_e, computes all pairwise intersections, proves only centered witness stars can yield higher nontrivial intersections at k>=4, and applies exact inclusion-exclusion with the correct disjoint-witness k=4 correction. The smaller k=3 case and n=4 exception are proved separately. Graph-adjacency verification found exact agreement across all n=4..7 subsets, sparse subsets n=8..10, and threshold checks n=5..49. Finite checks are explicitly not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact distribution counts every ordinary dominating set by cardinality for an infinite natural family containing the Petersen graph. The four-edge overlap term reflects a real crossing-witness obstruction, while the sharp threshold 2n-3 and exact boundary count supply meaningful robust-size information not contained in the known minimum domination number. The family and invariant are mathematically natural and not an arbitrary numerical slice.
